subject: BrightLeaf portal onboarding & evidence ownership
body:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Sara Cho <procurement@brightleaf.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-11 09:12 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding: BrightLeaf request

Hi Maya,

We’re ready to onboard Redwood into our vendor security tooling (Whistic + Vendr sync). Procurement needs the following by EOD next week so we can close the contract:

- Completed CAIQ or SIG-lite responses
- SOC 2 summary (scope + date)
- Contact for SSO/portal admin and an inventory owner list for evidence (who will be the people that can upload/rotate credentials)

Attaching BrightLeaf onboarding checklist for your side of the house. Please let me know if you prefer a portal invite or if we should collect artifacts by upload.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Cho
Procurement Manager
BrightLeaf Health
Attachment: BLH-vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf

--- Message 2 ---
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cho <procurement@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-11 10:08 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: BrightLeaf request

Hi Sara — thanks for the checklist. We can support Whistic and also push artifacts via a secure bucket if that’s easier for you. Quick answers:

- SOC 2: we’ll provide a one-page summary and the auditor name / date.
- CAIQ: we’ll upload a filled CAIQ spreadsheet into Whistic if you send the invite.
- SSO/Admin: primary admins will be Marissa Cole (contracts/portal admin) and Karthik Iyer (security lead).

Marissa — can you confirm you’re OK owning the portal invite + contract liaison?
Karthik — can you lead evidence ownership mapping and tell us if we need a temp S3 approach or to set up an account in Whistic?

I’m happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff with your security team early next week.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
--- Message 3 (internal) ---
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-11 11:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding: BrightLeaf request — internal tasking

Karthik/Rishi — looping you both in to scope the work. Quick proposed split:

1) Karthik: evidence ownership matrix (who on our side will upload each artifact), CAIQ mapping, and note which artifacts require rotation (keys/certs).
2) Rishi: approve and provision the temporary S3 bucket + service account if we go that route; confirm rotation policy and maintenance window.
3) Marissa: own the Whistic invite, contract liaison, and keep procurement looped on timelines.

Please reply with ETA. If either of you prefers we add a short runbook (steps, retention, who rotates creds) I’ll include that in the kickoff invite.

Thanks — Maya
--- Message 4 (external) ---
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@vendr.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Cho <sara.cho@brightleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12 09:23 -0700
Subject: Whistic invite + CAIQ for BrightLeaf onboarding

Hi Maya / Marissa —

I’ve sent a Whistic invite for BrightLeaf’s tenant: https://app.whistic.com/vendor/brightleaf/invite/XYZ123

If you accept, you’ll see the CAIQ template in the portal. I’ve also attached a pre-populated CAIQ we use as a starting point for vendors. BrightLeaf prefers SAML SSO but can accept a service account with scoped uploader rights for initial onboarding. A few practical notes:

- If you use a service account, make sure it only has upload rights to the evidence folder and credentials are rotated within 30 days.
- For large artifacts (>50MB) they expect a signed URL to our intake bucket; Vendr can proxy if you need.
- Please populate the CAIQ and mark owner for each line so BrightLeaf can validate quickly.

Attachment: BrightLeaf_CAIQ_responses.xlsx

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Vendor Ops — Vendr
--- Message 5 (internal) ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12 11:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Whistic invite + CAIQ for BrightLeaf onboarding — evidence mapping notes

Thanks for the invite link and the CAIQ. I reviewed the spreadsheet and recommend the following:

- Owners: I’ll assign items to product-security (KV cache, runtime infra), infra (S3/backups), and legal (policies). I’ll produce a one-page ownership matrix by EOD tomorrow.
- Sensitive artifacts: SOC 2 report + pen test deliverables should be uploaded to our private S3 bucket and shared as signed URLs rather than embedded in the portal.
- Temp S3: approved. Request Rishi to provision a scoped bucket (redwood-blh-onboard-temp) with a service account (uploader@redwood-onboard) limited to /brightleaf/uploads and a 30-day credential TTL.
- Rotation: suggest automated rotation via our secrets manager (Vault) and a short maintenance window at 03:00 UTC for the first upload to avoid Rate-limiting.

Quoted from Olivia’s note for context:
> If you use a service account, make sure it only has upload rights to the evidence folder and credentials are rotated within 30 days.

I’ll draft the matrix and upload the list to the shared Drive link once I have it.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
--- Message 6 (final) ---
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Cho <procurement@brightleaf.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@vendr.com>
Date: 2027-10-13 16:38 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLeaf portal onboarding & evidence ownership — next steps

Team / BrightLeaf — summary and next steps:

1) Whistic invite accepted (link above). Marissa, please confirm you have portal admin rights.
2) Karthik to deliver the evidence ownership matrix by 2027-10-14 EOD. He will flag artifacts that must be shared via signed URLs (SOC2, pentest).
3) Rishi to provision redwood-blh-onboard-temp bucket + uploader service account by 2027-10-15 and configure Vault rotation (30-day TTL).
4) I’ll attach the SOC 2 one-pager and the filled CAIQ responses to the Drive folder and notify BrightLeaf and Vendr for validation.

Attachments uploaded to Drive: BLH-SOC2-summary.pdf, BrightLeaf_CAIQ_responses.xlsx
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxxDocLink

Marissa — action: send the Whistic portal invite acceptance screenshot to procurement once you confirm role.
Karthik/Rishi — ping me if you need a brief walk-through with Vendr on the signed URL flow.

Thanks all — aim to close evidence intake by 2027-10-18 so procurement can finish.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Contact: maya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

--- End of thread ---
